stops.name: Sihlwald forest
stops.quote: It includes the Sihlwald forest, the largest mixed deciduous and coniferous forest in the Swiss Plateau (Swiss Mittelland), and the Langenberg Wildlife Park, the oldest Swiss wildlife park.
stops.english: It includes the Sihlwald forest, the largest mixed deciduous and coniferous forest in the Swiss Plateau (Swiss Mittelland), and the Langenberg Wildlife Park, the oldest Swiss wildlife park.

stops.name: Langenberg Wildlife Park
stops.quote: In 1869, Langenberg Wildlife Park was founded by the city forester Carl Anton Ludwig von Orelli.
stops.english: In 1869, Langenberg Wildlife Park was founded by the city forester Carl Anton Ludwig von Orelli.

stops.name: Sihl Valley
stops.quote: Both sites are situated in the Sihl Valley to the south of Zürich, but are separated from each other by the town of Langnau am Albis.
stops.english: Both sites are situated in the Sihl Valley to the south of Zürich, but are separated from each other by the town of Langnau am Albis.

stops.name: museum
stops.quote: Today, the park welcomes more than half a million yearly visitors, who are encouraged to barbecue, hike, cycle, and even ride horseback through the park, as well as visit its museum and attend various outdoor events.
stops.english: Today, the park welcomes more than half a million yearly visitors, who are encouraged to barbecue, hike, cycle, and even ride horseback through the park, as well as visit its museum and attend various outdoor events.

stops.name: Albis hills
stops.quote: It is situated on both banks of the Sihl river, although mostly on the western slopes rising up to the Albis hills.
stops.english: It is situated on both banks of the Sihl river, although mostly on the western slopes rising up to the Albis hills.
